disruptions.title: DODEKANISOS SEAWAYS - Trip schedule modifications on multiple routes
disruptions.content:
Dodekanisos Seaways has modified the departure and arrival times for the following trips on 1 November 2026:

  • Kalymnos - Rhodes will depart at 14:10 instead of 14:20 and arrive at 17:10 instead of 17:20.

  • Kos - Rhodes will depart at 14:50 instead of 15:00 and arrive at 17:10 instead of 17:20.

  • Symi - Rhodes will depart at 16:20 instead of 16:30 and arrive at 17:10 instead of 17:20.

disruptions.title: BLUE STAR FERRIES - Trip schedule modification for ferry NISSOS RODOS due to maintenance work
disruptions.content: Sunday, 1 November 2026: Due to essential maintenance work on the vehicle ramp, NISSOS RODOS will depart from Piraeus at 23:59 instead of 18:00, call at Kos from 10:00 to 10:20, and arrive in Rhodes at 13:30.
